items.title: 将当前 story 测试元数据纳入 metadata-only freshness
items.context: getEvidenceFreshness/isEvidenceMetadataOnlyPath 应把当前 story 目录下的 test-evidence.json、test-runs.json、bug.json、summary/review/implementation-review/checklist/index 等 Koala artifact 视为 metadata-only；但其它 story 或源码变化仍 stale。

happy.desc: 配置 storyDir=.koala/story/actives 时，提交当前 story 的 .koala/story/actives/<id>/test-evidence.json 与 test-runs.json 后 evidence freshness 仍为 metadata-only pass

edge.desc: 配置 storyDir=.koala/story/actives 时，提交 legacy docs/story/actives/<id>/test-evidence.json 后也被识别为当前 story metadata-only

adversarial.desc: 提交 docs/story/actives/<otherId>/test-evidence.json 或 .koala/story/actives/<otherId>/index.json 仍让 evidence stale

items.title: DONE gate stale 文案区分 metadata-only 与 source change
items.context: 当只有当前 story artifact 变化时显示 metadata-only pass；当源码或非当前 story artifact 变化时仍提示重跑 test_story。

happy.desc: 只有当前 story artifact 变化时 DONE checklist 显示 Test evidence PASS 且 detail 包含 metadata-only

edge.desc: 当前 story bug.json、summary.json、implementation-review.json 等 artifact 一起提交仍显示 metadata-only pass

adversarial.desc: 同一提交包含 src/app.ts 源码变化时 DONE checklist 显示 stale 并提示重跑 test_story

items.title: 增加 evidence freshness 回归 fixture
items.context: 覆盖 commit test-evidence/test-runs 后 freshness 仍 pass、当前 story bug/summary artifact pass、源码变化 fail、其它 story artifact fail。

happy.desc: fixture 覆盖新旧 story root 下 current story test-evidence/test-runs metadata-only pass

edge.desc: fixture 覆盖 current story 多种 artifact metadata-only pass

adversarial.desc: fixture 覆盖 other story artifact 与 source change stale fail
